evidence.brightness: per-channel gamma RGB sev5 (3.2). Additive shift families ruled out by clipping arithmetic: any shift ≥81 clips >12% of pair0 pixels vs target 6.3%. Final sim mean_shift -82.5 / clipped 0.0637 vs target -81.4 / 0.0634.
evidence.saturation: YCrCb sev2 (scale 0.4). Target chroma_ratio 0.341; final sim 0.320 (HSV2→0.445, HSV3→0.326 but PSNR 31.19 due to mean brightening). YCrCb preserves luminance → keeps shift/clip exact.
evidence.noise: NO_NOISE — sigma=1.48; peeled residual extreme_pct=50% is the documented false positive (sigma<5), spatial_corr 0.99 / cross_ch 0.95 structured.
evidence.order: blur(priority1) → brightness/saturation(priority2). Empirically: brightness-first 32.50 dB, sat-before-brightness 34.82 dB, blur-first 35.86 dB.
